literal_meaning: রাম এবং রহিম (হিন্দু ও মুসলিম নামের প্রতীক)
example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামের রাম-রহিম সবাই মিলে ঈদ-দুর্গাপূজা উদযাপন করে।
example_sentences_in_english: The Ram-Rahim of the village celebrate Eid and Durga Puja together.
Unity among Ram-Rahim is crucial in politics.
history: This idiom reflects the syncretic traditions of Bengal, where Hindu and Muslim communities have coexisted for centuries, often highlighted in literature and folklore during periods of communal harmony post-Partition of India.
note: The idiom symbolizes interfaith unity in Bengali culture.
